'''Danna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with his female partner, [[Gabriel]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were hauling [[Denta bean/Legends|denta beans]] to [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]]. During a stopover, Gabriel met a former smuggling [[Unidentified code dealer|associate]] who sold her that [[Standard month/Legends|month's]] codes to access [[Cynabar's InfoNet]]. She attempted to convince Danna to reroute to [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]], dump the denta beans for [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]], and pay off their outstanding amount on the ship in one go.
